feat: add short message extension

Add `ShortMessage` (`reactjs-tiptap-editor/shortmessage`): a keyboard-shortcut
driven snippet list. Pressing the configured shortcut (default `Mod-Space`)
opens a list of `{ short, long_content }` messages at the caret; typing filters
by `short`, Enter/click replaces the typed text with `long_content`, Escape or
blur closes it. Built on `@tiptap/suggestion` with a custom `findSuggestionMatch`
anchored at the shortcut position, so no trigger character is needed.

- register package export, `ExtensionNameKeys`, and `scripts/extensions.json`
- add `editor.shortMessage.empty` to all locales
- add docs page, sidebar entry, extension-map row, playground demo, type test

fix(export-pdf): keep columns side by side and stop relying on CDN styles

Reuse the host page's stylesheets in the print iframe, add an inline
fallback for `.columns/.column` layout, and wrap the content in
`.reactjs-tiptap-editor .ProseMirror` so scoped editor styles apply
when printing. Previously the print document was unstyled whenever the
CDN sheet could not load, collapsing columns into stacked blocks.

Closes #177
